notes.text: This landscape manuscript contains nine related structure blocks, twelve sphere drawings including one canceled drawing, three marginal graphs, two retraced marginal arrows and two long outer arcs. The main ink and pencil are treated as his hand; the light folio 30 is attributed only to another unnamed hand.

Pale blue laterally reversed computer listing shows through from the reverse. It is excluded entirely, including all 28 identical GUTS lines supplied by C. It is not treated as illegible front-side text.
The I10 expression visibly opens two parentheses and closes one after K. The unmatched formula is preserved without completing it.
The II2 block visibly combines B in two formulas with J in P in J and omega hooked into J. All letters are retained as written; no mathematical consistency correction was made.
The three I6 group symbols remain S/G ambiguities. Neither the expected symmetry group nor the wording of either witness was used to resolve them.

Reader C initially retained 1/prime ambiguity in the upper gamma_pi,s and 21/2prime in the outer gamma_r superscript. Root subsequently adjudicated both detached strokes as primes at medium confidence, using their lack of a numerical 1 hook or foot on the saved 031 crops and an independent notation comparison reported from 033. The current digits 2 in the III2prime heading, 60 in its text, 2 in niveau2 and the second 2 in III2 count are readable. They are retraced but no earlier digit is supplied. The current K is also legible without a secure prior form. Distinctly overlapping figure-label strokes remain flagged where they prevent a clean reading.

The broad lower gamma_r2 arc runs from III2prime to II2, with degree 2 at each end. This differs from both witnesses. The narrow outer-right gamma_r2prime arc runs from III2prime to I4, with 1 at the tail and 2 at the head.

The lower end of gamma_pi,rho has a curved hook but not a second complete arrowhead. The trace preserves that hook without assigning a second semantic direction. The upper marginal arrow likewise retains its mid-shaft meeting strokes.

Five large coloured points are distinguished from smaller black junctions. The canceled II2prime drawing has no securely surviving written point labels; C duplicated labels from its neighbouring drawing. The two lower right figures have eight black junctions each and visible black crosslinks absent from C.

Whole page and two native overlapping halves were each visually read once. Fifty-three distinct original crop rectangles were viewed once per place. One interrupted, invalid iii1_text PNG was preserved and recreated at the identical rectangle as documented in crop_recovery.json; no valid crop was replaced. No OCR, web research, other-page reader source, or TeX compilation was used.
